titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, BBC News
mainText: Six people died in a building explosion near the Acropolis in Athens; one victim was a British national.

titleText: JTF News: White House, PBS NewsHour
mainText: President Xi Jinping completed a 3-day state visit with President Trump.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, Deutsche Welle
mainText: China and the United States agreed to establish an artificial intelligence safety channel and continue trade and military talks.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, Deutsche Welle
mainText: The foreign ministers of Germany and Russia met at the United Nations General Assembly.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, PBS NewsHour
mainText: Pope Leo celebrated an open-air Mass in central Paris that drew 800,000 people.
